summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper and enumeration. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with the eleven members, values, and per-member comments. (2) botocore/args.py adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, imports the enum as EPRBuiltins after the botocore.endpoint import, and makes the STS predicate accept an absent endpoint configuration (treated as no variant tags). (3) tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py, and test_regions.py pass (415 tests). The full unit suite was not run. Notes: the bridge exposes its FIPS and DualStack lookups only as private methods (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var, _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint), so the helper calls those. FIPS and DualStack results are coerced with 'or False'. A pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (around line 315) was left unchanged. Nothing was committed.
